notes.title: Project Folder Coming Soon
notes.content:
In a week or two Chapter 9 should be finished and I'll have a project folder available in your Steam package! It won't be the winter scene, but it'll still demonstrate all the features I've made in GTGD S3 so far. 

I've gotten permissions form a number of Asset Store devs to redistribute their 3D artwork (wooden hut, guns, and barrels) so you'll get that and the rest of the 3D artwork is Unity artwork.

So in summary you'll finally have a complete project folder showing everything in action, and you'll be able to see how I've put prefabs together using my systems.

I believe I'll be changing out the store page trailer, images, and description as well to reflect the upcoming updates and contents of the project folder.

notes.title: Exclusive Content To Come
notes.content:
This Steam package does need exclusive content so I'm planning to cover at least two exclusive topics:

Game Design Practical Tips - What I've learnt for building a fun experience and keeping it manageable for a solo developer. (I'll aim for a May release)

The Road To Greenlight - At the end of the GTGD S3 tutorials I'll take the project forward and turn it into a fun game, and show how I approach Greenlight. (End of project release)

When GTGD S3 is complete I think the price will be somewhere from $9.99 to $11.99 so anyone buying it now is getting the learning package at a good price.

notes.title: Simple Multiplayer General Chapter!
notes.content:
I've just added a video adaption of Unity's new text based simple multiplayer tutorials. These are independent of the GTGD S3 chapters and will give you a basic introduction into Unity's new multiplayer system.

You'll find the videos in the Videos folder under General Chapter Unity 5 Simple Multiplayer and I've also included the project folder within the Scripts folder.
